programs.title: Drain the Oceans 6
programs.desc: More than 300 years ago, there was a maritime disaster on the Oregon coast.For generations, the indigenous inhabitants of this area have passed on stories about the accident and the surviving crew.Moreover, the waves continue to wash ashore the porcelain and wax that once rested in the hold.Archaeologists step into action.Specialists will attempt to reconstruct the ship.In the course of their work, researchers will use historical data and what they themselves have established.Viewers will learn, among other things, how this huge unit transported hundreds of tons over huge distances.
